# Biology Simulations

> Interactive virtual biology simulations and labs for classroom learning, data analysis, and inquiry-based exploration across cell biology, genetics, evolution, ecology, and anatomy.

Biology Simulations provides a comprehensive platform of interactive simulations designed for biology education. The platform covers major biological concepts including cellular processes, heredity, evolution, ecology, and human anatomy through hands-on virtual experiments and games.

## Key Topics

- interactive simulations
- virtual laboratory
- cell biology
- evolution and genetics
- ecology
- heredity
- anatomy
- inquiry-based learning
- data analysis
- classroom resources
- student engagement
- biology education
- population dynamics
- enzyme kinetics
- natural selection

## Interactive Simulations

- [Simulations Catalog](https://www.biologysimulations.com/simulations): Main catalog of interactive biology simulations for classroom experimentation
- [Cell Biology Simulations](https://www.biologysimulations.com/cell-biology): Cell biology simulations covering energy, cycle, diffusion, osmosis, and enzyme kinetics
- [Evolution Simulations](https://www.biologysimulations.com/evolution): Evolution simulations exploring natural selection, genetic drift, and population genetics
- [Ecology Simulations](https://www.biologysimulations.com/ecology): Ecology simulations for biodiversity, population dynamics, and ecosystem study
- [Heredity Simulations](https://www.biologysimulations.com/heredity): Heredity simulations teaching genetics, trait inheritance, and monohybrid crosses
- [Anatomy Simulations](https://www.biologysimulations.com/anatomy-1): Anatomy simulations including Hematocrit and labeling games for physiology learning

## Educational Resources

- [Resources](https://www.biologysimulations.com/resources): Teacher materials, worksheets, and downloadable resources for simulations
